row:
Dr. Rajneesh Kant is a renowned Chiropractor, Osteopath and Physiotherapist with over 22 years of experience in helping people understand, manage and overcome pain and movement-related problems.

On this channel, Dr. Rajneesh Kant shares practical and easy-to-understand information about:

- Back & Neck Pain
- Sciatica
- Joint Pain
- Knee & Shoulder Problems
- Headaches & Migraine
- Posture & Sitting Problems
- Sports Injuries
- Spinal Health & Mobility
- Physiotherapy & Rehabilitation
- Chiropractic & Osteopathic care
- Everyday habits that can contribute to pain

His mission is simple: “Dard Mukt Bharat” — A Pain-Free India.

Dr. Rajneesh Kant
Chiropractor | Osteopath | Physiotherapist
